name: Checkers
hook: Jump, chain the jumps, get crowned.
how: Classic 8×8 checkers: move diagonally, jump to capture (jumps are forced, and you keep jumping while you can), and reach the far side to become a king that moves both ways. The first two players take the seats; anyone else watches. Alone? A bot plays the other side.
controls: Click or tap a piece, then a dot (or drag it there)
uses: The host's browser checks every move; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot takes any empty seat, so you can play alone, and a friend who joins takes the bot's side.
Players and watchers see the same board, every hop and capture animated.
Most wins, shown after every game.
ideas: Let kings fly any distance along a diagonal
Add a 20-second timer for each move
Make it a candy board with gummy pieces
